zh: 对话行程卡默认显示第一天，每次预览一天，最多显示四项并标出其余数量。点“查看”可打开完整行程。
登录页按钮的文字可随系统字号调整，按钮全宽可点。
改善历史页标题、底栏未选中标签和图标，以及深色空行程页面按钮的可读性。
问题记录现在区分系统取消和网络故障。已受理的回答遇到服务不可用或限额时，可打开已有问题记录。
en: Chat itinerary cards start on day one. Preview one day at a time with up to four stops and a remaining count. Tap View for the full itinerary.
Sign-in buttons use scalable text and can be tapped across their full width.
Improve readability of chat history titles, inactive tab labels and icons, and the button on the empty Trips page in dark mode.
Problem notes now distinguish cancellation from network errors. If an accepted reply fails due to service availability or a limit, you can open existing problem notes.

zh: 与构建 46 相比，逐日展开改为单日预览，深色模式下卡片站点文字更清楚。
构建 47 也改善了登录、历史和底栏的显示，以及回答失败后的提示。
en: Compared with build 46, cards preview a single day instead of expanding every day. Stop text is easier to read in dark mode.
Build 47 also improves sign-in, history and tab presentation and guides you to problem notes after an accepted reply fails.

zh: ① 打开 App，确认回到之前的对话并能看到消息。② 新建对话，问“北京是中国的首都吗？”，等到完整回答。
③ 打开历史对话列表，确认能找到并打开对话。④ 留一段未发送的草稿，锁屏或切后台 10 秒，再回来确认是同一对话，草稿仍在。
⑤ 问“你是谁”，查看首条回答。⑥ 问“你能做啥”，查看能力说明。⑦ 问“北京三日游”，核对第 1 至第 3 天都有具体安排。第 ⑤ 至 ⑦ 项分别从新对话开始。
每项记下大概时间。遇到失败请截图，在“问题记录”里点“复制”，提供已有记录。保留当前账号、消息和草稿。
en: ① Open the app and verify that your previous chat and messages return. ② Start a new chat, ask “Is Beijing the capital of China?” and wait for a complete reply.

③ Open chat history and verify that you can find and open a conversation. ④ Leave an unsent draft, lock your phone or background the app for 10 seconds, then check that the same chat and draft return.

⑤ Ask “Who are you?” and check the first reply. ⑥ Ask “What can you do?” and check the capabilities. ⑦ Ask “A three-day trip to Beijing” and check for concrete plans for days 1–3. Use a fresh chat for each of steps ⑤–⑦.
Note the approximate time for each step. If something fails, take a screenshot and tap Copy in Problem notes to share any existing record. Keep your current account, messages and drafts.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 本轮只检查一次简单北京规划，确认有完整三天安排。
行程正式保存、修改与撤销，以及全国规划仍在验证。
“记住”偏好仍需单独完成真实验收。
本轮使用系统默认字号。较大字号下仍有卡片显示或切日问题。
分段、多选探索尚未默认开启；真机弱网和长时间锁屏恢复仍待完整验证。
行程详情的完整无障碍检查仍未通过，尚未认定已修复。
en: For planning, this check covers one simple Beijing request and a complete three-day itinerary.
Formal itinerary saving, edits and undo, and planning across China are still being validated.
Remember preferences still requires a separate live check.
Use the system default text size. Card display or day selection can still have issues at larger sizes.
Segmented, multiple-choice exploration is not the default. Physical-device weak-network and longer lock-screen recovery checks remain pending.
Trip details have not yet passed their complete accessibility checks; this remains unresolved.

zh: 本版准备时，香港在线服务来源为 1ff3941e，并沿用已有账号资格和额度规则。
以上界面修正需要更新 App。这个构建不附带服务端部署。
en: At preparation, the Hong Kong service is on source 1ff3941e with the current account eligibility and allowance rules.
Install the app update to get these interface changes. This build ships without a server deployment.
Keep the same chat and each unsent draft when returning to the App.
During a recoverable connection check, keep the current chat visible instead of starting over.
Invitation entry avoids automatic capitalization and smart punctuation, and explains the required format.
Fix sign-in for valid test accounts that have no earlier demo content.
The information page keeps Done reachable after reading a long update.
zh: 回到应用时保留同一对话，以及各段对话里尚未发送的草稿。
遇到可恢复的连接检查时保留当前对话，不再重新开始。
邀请码输入关闭自动大写和智能标点，格式有误时直接说明正确格式。
修复有效测试账号缺少旧演示内容时无法完成登录的问题。
长篇说明翻到底后，仍能方便地点“完成”返回。

en: Since build 45: fix a local recovery problem that could be triggered by an unrelated pending message.
Ordinary travel wording no longer hides an otherwise complete reply. Original failed messages retain their original outcome.
zh: 与构建 45 相比：修复一种由无关待发消息触发的本机恢复问题。
普通旅行用语不再单独导致完整回答被隐藏；过去失败的消息仍保留当时结果。

en: Leave a draft in an existing chat, switch to another app, then return and check the same chat and text.
Force-quit and reopen, then check the same conversation and draft.
In new chats, ask “Who are you?” and “What can you do?” in Chinese or English.
Ask for a three-day trip to Beijing and check that all three days contain a concrete plan.
zh: 在已有对话中留一段草稿，切到其他应用后返回，核对同一对话和文字。
强制关闭应用后重开，检查同一对话和草稿。
新建对话，用中文或英文分别问“你是谁”“你能做啥”。
询问“北京三日游”，查看是否有完整三天的具体安排。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Formal itinerary saving, edits and undo, and planning across China are still being validated.
Remember preferences still requires a separate live check.
Segmented, multiple-choice exploration is not the default. Complete physical-device and weak-network acceptance remains pending.
zh: 行程正式保存、修改与撤销，以及全国规划仍在验证。
“记住”偏好仍需单独完成真实验收。
分段、多选探索尚未默认开启；真机与弱网完整验收仍待完成。

en: The paired Hong Kong service source 1ff3941e includes improvements to chat history, English city requests and lodging preferences.
These service changes apply automatically without a separate app update. Account qualification and allowances keep their existing rules.
zh: 配套香港服务来源为 1ff3941e，包含历史查看、英文城市理解及住宿偏好识别的改进。
这些服务端更新自动生效，无需单独更新应用；账号资格和额度维持既有规则。
